title: AES256Afro/Porchlight
summary: Security inspection on your own computer: committed credentials and vulnerable dependencies across git repositories, a Cloudflare Worker that monitors domains you own, a rule-based audit of your Cloudflare account, and a read-only check of the computer. Web interface, CLI and container on Linux and macOS; desktop app on macOS; Windows planned.

title: sergenes/scootcli
summary: A tiny coding agent that goes where you point it. Stdlib-only Python, one-file zipapp, works with OpenAI and Ollama (Anthropic next). Terminal REPL with an agentic loop, tools, approvals, and drop-in extension registries.

title: townlight/townlight
summary: Townlight municipal software: Windows public beta with Records, Meetings, Code, Zoning, Planning, Permitting, Inspections, Access, Notice, Boards, Contracts and Procurement; shared Core and separately configured Station.

title: caeser-org/ceaser
summary: CI failure investigation, starting with Go. Connects CI evidence to source code, narrows likely causes, and posts actionable PR reports. Optional AI analysis.

title: dmae97/omk
summary: Open-source multi-agent coding CLI for the terminal (TypeScript, MIT). Switch models mid-session; finish goals only when your test passes.

title: SterburnDev/polox
summary: A cozy, local-first 3D life-sim: draw your own friends, talk with them (they remember you), build rooms and dream worlds. Free and open source, made with Godot. Windows + Android, no accounts, no ads.

title: dragonked2/alphacode
summary: Free MIT AI coding agent — no API key needed. Built-in free model, or bring Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama +50 more. Swarm mode, 40+ tools, browser & desktop automation, built in Rust.

title: nsozturk/venice-bridge
summary: venice-bridge is a free, open-source local bridge for macOS that lets OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI and other coding agents use a venice.ai web subscription, with working tool calls.

title: vaibhav-barman/self-rag
summary: Self-reflective RAG with LangGraph: retrieval decisions, relevance and grounding checks, query rewrite

title: raro42/mac-stats
summary: Menu-bar system monitor for Apple Silicon (optional local AI agent). Rust + Tauri. No cloud telemetry.

title: louisfifre/deckle
summary: A local companion for Windows 11: one app, many modules, each turned on or off as you like. Voice dictation first, then typing, lights, trackpad, smooth scrolling. Every module works out of the box, with every setting at hand when you want more. Nothing leaves your machine.

title: JoeSupportWiz/Assay
summary: Customise, sign and inspect your iPhone — in one workbench that shows its work. ✦ SwiftUI · iOS 17+

title: sv222/ai-guard-k8s
summary: Archived: merged into kshield (github.com/sv222/kshield). Scanner for Kubernetes AI inference workloads (vLLM, Ollama, Triton, TGI, Ray Serve) with Kyverno and Cilium policy output.

title: oib/AITBC
summary: A comprehensive blockchain-based marketplace for AI computing services with zero-knowledge proof verification and confidential transaction support.

title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
summary: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.

title: Archimedes79/Tell-and-Wire
summary: No-code visual node editor for AI workflows and small local tools: describe each node in plain words, AI writes its code or prompt, wire nodes into a graph and run it offline with a local LLM. Local-first, no telemetry, no account. Source-available, free for noncommercial use.

title: willdady/platypus
summary: Self-hosted AI Agents for your whole team — on your infrastructure, your models, around the clock.

title: usetheokit/theokit-sdk
summary: Open-source TypeScript SDK and agent runtime you own end to end. Agent.create / prompt / stream / resume, 43 LLM providers on your own keys, MCP with OAuth PKCE, subagents, workflows, evals, memory, and a bubblewrap+seccomp kernel sandbox for tool execution. Local-first, opt-in cloud, Apache-2.0.

title: Loganwins/ProprioceptiveAI
summary: Local AI interface for token certainty, double-checking, hidden-state behaviour probes, model steering, and private memory.
